mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_projects (code, name, description, kind, category, repo_path, base_branch, success_code_path, success_code_value, enabled, sort_order, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{description}, #{kind}, #{category}, #{repoPath}, #{baseBranch}, #{successCodePath}, #{successCodeValue}, #{enabled}, #{sortOrder}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE api_projects SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, kind = #{kind}, category = #{category}, repo_path = #{repoPath}, base_branch = #{baseBranch}, success_code_path = #{successCodePath}, success_code_value = #{successCodeValue}, enabled = #{enabled}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE code = #{code}
